title: (Bug 641089) Guard Item Ledger/Value Entry No. allocation in Item Jnl.-Post Line with CommitBehavior::Ignore
summary: Item journal posting now prevents duplicate-key errors in concurrent scenarios by wrapping split posting in a commit-behavior guard frame, with an event for callers that need commits honored.
key_points: Entry number allocation for Item Ledger and Value Entries is protected by CommitBehavior::Ignore guard
OnSetCommitBehavior event allows subscribers to opt out and restore legacy commit behavior if needed
Pattern mirrors existing guard in General Journal posting
Applied across all regional layers (W1, APAC, CH, ES, IT, RU)
Two tests verify commit suppression and opt-out behavior
